name: Brother Joshua
summary: In Stormwind, Brother Joshua guides those who come to the Cathedral of Light to learn the ways of the Holy Light. He trains novice priests to heal wounds and strengthen their allies.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Cathedral
sections.body: Brother Joshua waits near the main altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, ready to teach new servants of the faith. A priest of the Church of the Holy Light, he instructs them in healing, protective wards, and the focus needed to commune with the Light. Young human priests beginning their service to the Alliance find one of their first guides in him.

faq.answer: Brother Joshua is a human priest and trainer of the Church of the Holy Light. He teaches aspiring priests their spells, rituals, and sacred duties in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Where can I find Brother Joshua?
faq.answer: Brother Joshua stands near the high altar toward the back of the Cathedral of Light, in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.
Brother Joshua teaches priests new ranks of divine and restorative spells and can reset their spiritual talents.

angles.text: As a priest, you can study the Holy Light with Brother Joshua in Stormwind and learn new prayers and disciplines as you advance.
As an Alliance member, you can find Joshua in the Cathedral of Light, at the heart of your kingdom.
